channel.description: Legitimate paid-writing opportunities, practical guides and BRYME's firsthand verification record.

item.title: Overtime: $40-$60 per story, 5,000-10,000 words
item.description: Overtime, the one-story chapbook series from Workers Write!, pays $40 to $60 per story, depending on length and rights available.

item.title: Old Pal: $50 on publication, poetry, prose, art
item.description: Old Pal compensates contributors $50 upon publication for poetry, fiction, criticism, excerpts, audio, mixed media and art, with all rights reverting to the

item.title: Nimrod International Journal
item.description: Nimrod pays $20 per poem and per page of prose, with a $300 maximum, and its general submission window is open this October, 1-31, free online or by post.

item.title: Mulberry Literary
item.description: Mulberry Literary pays a flat $25 USD for each piece accepted, through PayPal, and sends contributors the issue their work appears in.

item.title: Let me tell you a story
item.description: Let me tell you a story pays $10 CAD for each accepted flash fiction piece and states that it never charges fees.

item.title: The Lemonwood Quarterly

item.title: Kweli Journal: pays contributors
item.description: Kweli Journal states that payment for published work is made after publication, but does not publish an amount.

item.title: Exposition Review
item.description: Exposition Review pays $50.00 USD for accepted work and leaves copyright with the author, asking only that a later reprint cites the magazine.

item.title: Claudine: $25 per micro on publication, 400 words
item.description: Claudine pays $25 on publication for microfiction and micro creative nonfiction of up to 400 words, a firm limit, and never charges a submission fee.
